zoe: Follow-up from KV-evict postmortem  owners + test additions. Quick bullets below.
raj: please assign owners.
zoe: owners: prompt-regression -> @ellen; nightly replay -> @mike; chaos run + rollback dry-run -> @raj. ETAs: promptset 8bd, replay 5bd, chaos 14bd.
ellen: taking prompt-regression. will extract 25 edge prompts from logs and add to evals/regressions/kv-evict/. need s3 path.
zoe: path: s3://pm-logs/kv-evict/2026-03-22/. use tools/ops_extract.py to pull samples.
mike: nightly replay accepted. will create k8s CronJob hitting staging at 03:00 UTC, capped to 40 concurrency and max_tokens 240. will post helm PR.
raj: chaos plan: simulate staggered KV node loss (25% -> 70% over 20m) on staging, ramp traffic, validate fallback to model "latency-safe-1" and monitor fallback_rate. need 2hr window and IR signoff. drill-bot can you request window?
drill-bot: window request queued. Proposed: 2026-04-10 08:00-10:00 UTC. IR approval required by 48h prior. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
ellen: how will CI gating work for promptset?
zoe: add a GH Action in evals repo that runs similarity checks and fails if top-1 accuracy drops > 3% or median latency increases > 12%. i'll add the PR.
mike: adding console metrics: kv_hit_rate, fallback_rate, and routing_fallback_latency. opening console ticket.
zoe: recap actions:
- ellen: curate promptset + add CI (8bd)
- mike: nightly replay helm + staging deploy (5bd)
- raj: chaos drill runbook + rollback dry-run (14bd)
- zoe: PRs + quarterly recurrence GH issue
zoe: marking blockers if no start by EOD Tue. ping @here for visibility :eyes:
